items.name: amb-underleaf-day
items.prompt: Ambience of an enchanted giant forest floor in late afternoon, heard from the ground among huge leaves and roots: a soft breeze high in giant leaves, distant gentle insect chirps and buzzing, an occasional far-off bird, a faint trickle of water, and a barely audible shimmering ethereal tone like distant glass chimes, mysterious and calm. No music, no voices, steady and even.
items.title: Underleaf ambience (day)

items.name: amb-underleaf-night
items.prompt: Night ambience of an enchanted giant forest floor: deep calm darkness, slow soft wind in giant leaves, crickets and night insects far and near, a distant owl-like call, a faint trickle of water, and a low ethereal shimmering hum with occasional soft glassy chimes, mysterious and a little eerie. No music, no voices, steady and even.
items.title: Underleaf ambience (night)
